content.user_title: Plan a paid campaign bid strategy
content.value_statement: Paid campaigns can stall when bid targets do not match available conversion data. This skill recommends a strategy, derives a starting target, and plans a controlled learning-phase entry.
actual_capabilities: Selects tCPA, tROAS, max-conversions, max-conversion-value, or manual CPC from stated goals and conversion volume.
Derives a starting tCPA or tROAS target from provided achievable CPA or ROAS history.
Labels planning inputs as Measured, User-provided, or Estimated.
Groups compatible campaigns into bid portfolios based on goal, target range, and funnel stage.
Creates a learning-phase entry plan with a review date and change restrictions.
Flags missing data and requests an export instead of inventing performance metrics.
limitations: It does not connect to advertising platforms or retrieve live campaign data by itself.
Its volume thresholds and learning estimates are rules of thumb, not platform guarantees.
It does not allocate campaign budgets or manage in-flight pacing changes.
Recommendations depend on accurate conversion, CPA, ROAS, and campaign-goal data.

use_cases.title: Launch a direct-response campaign
use_cases.description: Choose an initial tCPA or tROAS strategy from the campaign goal and recent conversion history.

use_cases.title: Restructure a search portfolio
use_cases.description: Separate prospecting and direct-response campaigns into compatible bidding portfolios.

use_cases.title: Prepare a learning-phase plan
use_cases.description: Document target-change limits, estimated exit conditions, and a safe review date before launch.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a basic strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Choose a bid strategy for my lead campaign. The last 30 days produced 40 conversions at a $55 CPA. Explain the starting target.

prompt_templates.title: Set a revenue target
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a starting tROAS target for my ecommerce campaign. The trailing 30-day ROAS is 3.6x, and the business goal is 4.2x.

prompt_templates.title: Group campaign portfolios
prompt_templates.prompt: Group these campaigns into bid portfolios: two direct-response search campaigns at similar CPA, one prospecting campaign, and one brand campaign with a hard bid cap.

prompt_templates.title: Create a complete entry plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a bid-strategy recommendation and learning-phase entry plan. Include the target math, portfolio map, assumptions, risks, and missing data I must provide.

output_examples.input: A lead campaign has 90 monthly conversions and a trailing CPA of $42.
output: Recommended strategy: tCPA because conversion volume supports a target strategy.
Starting target: $42 to $46, based on the achievable trailing CPA.
Learning plan: avoid target and budget changes during the initial review window.

output_examples.input: An ecommerce campaign has thin conversion volume but reliable order values.
output: Recommended strategy: max-conversion-value without a target initially.
Reason: value data exists, but volume is too limited for a stable tROAS target.
Next step: reassess tROAS after value conversions stabilize.

best_practices: Provide trailing 30-day conversion volume and achievable CPA or ROAS before requesting a target.
Keep prospecting and direct-response campaigns in separate portfolios unless their goals and economics match.
Wait through the planned learning window before making material target, budget, or structure changes.
anti_patterns: Do not set a tCPA or tROAS target from an aspirational number the account has not achieved.
Do not mix campaigns with different goals or target economics in one bid portfolio.
Do not treat estimated thresholds as a substitute for account performance data.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the campaign goal, trailing CPA or ROAS, conversion volume, current strategy, and relevant campaign constraints.

faq.question: When should I use tCPA?
faq.answer: Use tCPA when the campaign has a fixed cost-per-action goal and sufficient recent conversion volume.

faq.question: When should I use tROAS?
faq.answer: Use tROAS when revenue value data is reliable and the campaign has sufficient value conversion signal.

faq.question: What if conversion volume is low?
faq.answer: Start with max-conversions, max-conversion-value, or manual CPC as appropriate, then reassess when data grows.

faq.question: Does this skill change my live campaigns?
faq.answer: No. It produces a recommendation and planning artifacts. Apply changes only after reviewing them.

faq.question: Can it manage campaign budgets?
faq.answer: No. Budget allocation and in-flight pacing are outside this skill scope.
